title: Script header
description: The machine-readable header every script carries (docs/scripts.md): a YAML block under a `# hnx-script:` comment line near the top of the file. Consumed by `hnx scripts` (checklist M-01, M-02, M-04).

id.description: Unique across the repository; the catalog key.

kind.description: check: decides whether a standing property of the repository or the platform holds (exit 0 = holds) and runs through the invariants runner. tool: run by a person, a make target, CI or another script for one run's purpose. job: a one-shot task an orchestrator starts. service: a long-running process.

status.description: active (default) must have a caller; deprecated may have none.

owner.description: Who answers for it: a team or area slug, never a person.

trigger.description: Every caller, exactly as `hnx scripts reality` discovers them, plus `manual` for a person.

exit.description: Exit-code contract: code -> meaning. 0 is always documented.

invariant.description: Invariants criteria that run this check (kind: check only).

installs_to.description: Absolute path the script is installed at on a host, so a unit's ExecStart resolves to it.

then.description: a check documents a failing code in 1..99 (semantic rule in homelabnext.scripts.header)
